{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Confirm the number of missing values in 'flipper_length_mm'
missing_flipper = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()
print(f"Number of missing values in 'flipper_length_mm': {missing_flipper}")

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Confirm the number of rows after dropping
print(f"Number of rows after dropping missing flipper length: {len(penguins_clean)}")

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
mean_flipper_by_species_sorted = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Display the result
print("\nMean flipper length by species:")
display(mean_flipper_by_species_sorted)

# Get the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species_sorted.iloc[0]['species']
print(f"\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")"}
